extracted.name: Easy Pork Tenderloin Tips
extracted.description: Use a lower-grade cut of pork and a slow cooker to make a delicious main course with just a few ingredients.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
2 (1 ounce) packages dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Stir mushroom soup, onion soup mix, and white wine together in a slow cooker; add pork tenderloin tips and stir to coat, making sure to separate the pieces of meat.
Cook on Low overnight to 8 hours.
